title: Krawtchouk value on the cube
statement: For a sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ and a natural number $j$, its Krawtchouk value is the sum of the degree-$j$ cube monomials evaluated at $x$, over all subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ of size $j$.
caveat: The definition of the cube monomial is not included, so its precise convention is unavailable.
